about: Before/after comparisons shown on the metrics page. See metrics/README.md for how to add numbers. null = not measured yet; "n/a" = the before version cannot do this at all.

comparisons.title: Supervisor agent
comparisons.summary: An AI supervisor commands the drones through seven tools; the pilot grants autonomy and can always override. Rounds use a scripted supervisor that re-plans every second. Build and download numbers cover everything merged from main, including voice Recall.

comparisons.title: Voice agent for motion control
comparisons.summary: Voice proposes Deploy, Recall and Fire at Will orders. The simulation still decides, and Recall keeps priority.

metrics.name: Minimum time to issue Deploy or Recall
metrics.note: Before: the gesture must be held for COMMAND_HOLD_MS (500 ms). After: end of speech to order accepted.

metrics.name: Recall-priority checks passing
metrics.note: Recall must still beat a pending or voice-issued order. Run the same Recall checks on both versions.

comparisons.title: Tactical HUD and arena effects
comparisons.summary: A hologram HUD with drone tags, voice and agent feedback, plus presentation-only arena effects. Measures what they cost to download and run.

comparisons.title: Loading the 3D engine on demand
comparisons.summary: Three.js now downloads in the background after the setup screen appears, instead of before it.
